response:
Reflection: the leader is now **TriDeflatorGatedYield** (fmb 5.01, FF5 alpha 6.3%/yr, t 4.24, Sharpe 0.586) — a three-lens rank blend of pre-investment cash earning power times the current-flow intangible weight. Gen-5 also reported all the component tests the critic asked for: the broad hidden-capital weight reached 5.4%/t 3.99, the persistent-commitment weight 4.3%/t 3.41, the dual-profit blend 4.2%/t 3.19, and the gated gross-profit conversion 4.3%/t 3.41. The evidence is consistent: gains come from **blending noisy lenses on the yield side**, while the weight side is a plateau where several economically different measures perform similarly. With three generations left, the right move is disciplined consolidation — hold the winning yield blend fixed and vary exactly one thing per proposal — plus two attribution tests that the program's credibility now requires: whether the mechanical R&D add-back drives the result, and whether the effect is firm-level or industry-level.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: TriDeflatorBroadCapitalWeight
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), at), SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), sale), MUL(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), SUB(revt, cogs)), INDICATOR(SUB(revt, cogs), 0))))), WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(intan, 0), ADD(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3), TS_SUM(SUB(xsga, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), 3))), at), 1))
HYPOTHESIS: The blended measure of pre-investment cash earning power should be tilted by a firm's total hidden capital — knowledge, brand, organization and purchased intangibles — because all four are productive assets the balance sheet either omits or distorts.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The two ingredients have now each reported strong standalone results with the other held at its archived setting (tri-deflator blend 6.3%/t 4.24 with the flow weight; broad hidden-capital weight 5.4%/t 3.99 with the single asset deflator), so combining them is a justified consolidation rather than an untested stack. If alpha exceeds 6.3% the two improvements are additive and the final generations should standardize on this pairing; if not, the weight dimension has genuinely plateaued.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: TriDeflatorCommitmentWeight
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), at), SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), sale), MUL(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), SUB(revt, cogs)), INDICATOR(SUB(revt, cogs), 0))))), WINSOR(TS_MIN(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), at), 5), 1))
HYPOTHESIS: Durable investment commitment, measured as the floor of five years of intangible intensity, identifies firms whose off-balance-sheet asset is real and continuously replenished, and pairing it with the blended yield should produce a cleaner validated-productivity portfolio than a single-year spending weight.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The commitment weight was the highest-scoring new conditioning idea of gen 5 (alpha 4.3%, t 3.41 against a single-deflator yield), and it excludes firms whose intensity is a one-year spike — exactly the names most likely to churn in and out of the extreme deciles and depress the t-statistic. Holding the yield blend fixed makes this a clean one-dimension comparison against both the flow-weight leader and Signal 1.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: IncomeStatementTriDeflatorYield
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(oibdp, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), at), SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(oibdp, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), sale), MUL(RATIO(ADD(oibdp, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), SUB(revt, cogs)), INDICATOR(SUB(revt, cogs), 0))))), WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), at), 1))
HYPOTHESIS: Pre-investment operating earning power measured entirely from the income statement captures the same hidden-asset productivity as the cash-flow-statement version, so the winning blend should survive on a panel roughly 60% larger, free of working-capital noise.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Every top signal in the archive is capped at coverage 0.089 by oancf, which leaves the finding vulnerable to the charge that it is a modern, larger-firm phenomenon; the oibdp construct already delivered t 3.60 at coverage 0.145 with a single deflator, so applying the winning three-lens blend to it tests breadth without changing the mechanism. A comparable alpha on the wider panel would materially strengthen the economic case, and a weaker one would pin the effect on cash-flow-statement information specifically.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: NoAddBackTriDeflatorYield
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(SUMRANK(RATIO(oancf, at), SUMRANK(RATIO(oancf, sale), MUL(RATIO(oancf, SUB(revt, cogs)), INDICATOR(SUB(revt, cogs), 0))))), WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), at), 1))
HYPOTHESIS: If the family's power reflects genuine intangible productivity rather than the mechanical correlation induced by adding intangible spending into the numerator while also using it as the conditioning weight, then the blended yield should retain most of its alpha when the add-back is removed.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The critic correctly flagged that the R&D-and-advertising add-back re-enters the signal through the weight, so a heavy spender is mechanically pushed up the yield ranking regardless of productivity; this proposal removes the add-back and changes nothing else, making it the decisive attribution test for the whole program. A large drop would mean the effect is partly a construction artifact and the last generations should be spent on add-back-free formulations, while a modest drop would confirm the economics.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: MaterialityGatedTriDeflatorYield
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), at), SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), sale), MUL(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), SUB(revt, cogs)), INDICATOR(SUB(revt, cogs), 0))))), INDICATOR(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(intan, 0), TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3)), at), 0.10))
HYPOTHESIS: Accounting mismeasurement is a regime, not a continuum: once hidden capital exceeds roughly a tenth of reported assets the balance sheet is materially wrong, and beyond that threshold additional intensity adds noise rather than information.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Every archive signal weights the yield by a fat-tailed intensity ratio, so the extreme deciles are dominated by a handful of very high-intensity names, which is a plausible source of the residual instability in ls_talpha; a binary materiality gate equalizes influence across all materially intangible firms and should raise Sharpe and t if concentration has been costly. Unlike the gen-1 hard-gate proposal that was rejected as "profitability on a sample filter," the gated quantity here is an intangible-adjusted, three-lens yield rather than standard ROA, so the interaction remains substantive.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: IndustryIntensityWeightedYield
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), at), SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), sale), MUL(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), SUB(revt, cogs)), INDICATOR(SUB(revt, cogs), 0))))), WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), at), IND_ADJ(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), at))), 1))
HYPOTHESIS: If intangible mismeasurement is pervasive at the industry level — pharmaceuticals, software, branded consumer — then the profitability tilt should pay off in proportion to the *industry's* intangible intensity rather than the individual firm's deviation from it.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Subtracting the industry-adjusted intensity from raw intensity recovers the industry mean, giving a weight that varies only across industries and is constant within them, which cleanly separates the industry-level from the firm-level version of the mechanism. This matters for interpretation and for risk: if the industry weight performs as well as the firm weight, the archive's alpha is largely an unhedged sector tilt that FF5 does not absorb, and the final generations should incorporate within-industry weighting instead.
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel

---CRITIQUE TriDeflatorBroadCapitalWeight---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: A legitimate one-dimension consolidation of two independently validated components (tri-deflator yield × broad hidden-capital weight), but it is a factorial recombination of archived pieces with limited new economic content, so it should be judged strictly on whether alpha exceeds the 6.3% incumbent rather than treated as a new mechanism.

---CRITIQUE TriDeflatorCommitmentWeight---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Internally consistent and cleanly controlled (only the weight changes), and the TS_MIN commitment floor has a real turnover-stability rationale distinct from a stock measure, but like Signal 1 it is another weight swap on the same yield blend and the two proposals largely compete for the same marginal information.

---CRITIQUE IncomeStatementTriDeflatorYield---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 4
RATIONALE: A well-motivated breadth/robustness test that holds the mechanism fixed while replacing oancf with oibdp to lift coverage from ~0.089 to ~0.145, and it is genuinely informative either way since a comparable alpha rules out a cash-flow-statement-era artifact.

---CRITIQUE NoAddBackTriDeflatorYield---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 4
RATIONALE: This is the single most valuable proposal here because it is a clean ablation of the mechanical numerator-weight correlation that plausibly inflates the entire archive family, though reviewers should note that the stripped-down version is close to cash-based operating profitability interacted with R&D intensity, both well-documented, so a "modest drop" result still leaves a rediscovery question.

---CRITIQUE MaterialityGatedTriDeflatorYield---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: Multiplying by a 0/1 indicator collapses the interaction into a plain cash-profitability sort on an intangible-intensity subsample with all other firms pinned at exactly zero (a design that already failed in the archive as ReturnOnIntangibleCapital, fmb 0.32), so the "conditional" structure is nominal and the surviving content is the known cash-based operating profitability anomaly.

---CRITIQUE IndustryIntensityWeightedYield---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 4
RATIONALE: The algebra does what the hypothesis claims — raw minus industry-adjusted intensity recovers an industry-constant weight — making this a genuinely diagnostic decomposition of firm-level versus sector-level mismeasurement, with the caveat that the whole construction hinges on IND_ADJ being exact industry demeaning and that an industry-constant multiplier applied to an already industry-z-scored yield produces an unhedged sector-amplitude tilt whose FF5 alpha must be interpreted accordingly.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: BoundedRankWeightTriDeflatorYield
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), at), SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), sale), MUL(RATIO(ADD(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), SUB(revt, cogs)), INDICATOR(SUB(revt, cogs), 0))))), MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), at)), INDICATOR(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), at), 0)))
HYPOTHESIS: Mispricing rises monotonically with intangible intensity but with diminishing sensitivity — a firm spending 25% of assets on R&D is not five times more mismeasured than one spending 5% — so the conditioning weight should preserve the ordering of intangible intensity while bounding the influence of the extreme-intensity tail.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional
REASONING: This replaces the 0/1 gate the critic rejected with a continuous, bounded weight, so the interaction stays genuinely conditional: the profitability tilt still scales with how intangible-intensive a firm is, rather than being switched on for a subsample. Multiplying the industry rank by a strictly-positive-spending indicator keeps non-spenders at exactly zero, which fixes the tied-mid-rank defect that made earlier IND_RANK weights dilute the signal, while capping the decile influence of a handful of very high-intensity names that plausibly explains the residual instability in ls_talpha.
